input.text: Part 5 of the Online Safety Act 2023 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2024 applies.

references.literal: Part 5 of the Online Safety Act 2023 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2024

_note: A statutory instrument MADE UNDER the host Act, named by extending the host's own name, is a DIFFERENT, EXTERNAL instrument — never INTERNAL to the host merely because its name starts with the host's own name. Constructed wording.
